title: Some commissions don't just create a character they create someone's alter ego."
content: Some commissions don't just create a character they create someone's alter ego." This wasn't just about drawing a guy with a sword. It was about designing someone who looks like he owns the city before he even says a word. The red streak wasn't chosen because it looked cool. The jacket wasn't there just for style. The pose wasn't random. Every choice was made to tell the same story: "This is someone you don't want to underestimate." That's my favorite part of commission work. People don't come to me looking for another generic character they come with an idea that's been living in their head for weeks, months, sometimes years. My job is to turn that idea into someone who feels alive. And honestly, that's what keeps every project exciting. If you've got a character that's still trapped in your imagination, let's change that. DM me to book your digital art commission.
